'''Black diamonds''' are particularly rare [[gem]]s, similar to [[yellow diamond|yellow]], [[red diamond|red]], [[blue diamond|blue]], [[green diamond|green]] and [[clear diamond|clear]] [[diamond]]s - they occur only as individual gems within existing [[vein|clusters]] of [[faint yellow diamond]]s, which are themselves found only within [[kimberlite]], itself found only within [[gabbro]] [[stone layers|layers]]. Correspondingly, they are among the most [[item value|valuable]] gems that can be found in ''Dwarf Fortress''.

{{d for dwarf}}
A black diamond will not manufacture [[cheese]] in any form.  Their presence also does not indicate difficult skiing conditions.
